# telnyx_messaging_hosted_number_order_verification_codes (Action)

Sends verification codes by call or SMS to numbers in a messaging hosted number order. Submit the codes with telnyx_messaging_hosted_number_order_validation_codes.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messaging_hosted_number_order_id` (String) The messaging hosted number order id.
- `phone_numbers` (List of String) The +E.164 phone numbers of the order to send codes to.
- `verification_method` (String) How the codes are delivered: by phone call or SMS. One of `call`, `sms`.
